'''January 2000 Las Vegas tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, Nevada on 29 January 2000. [[Kris Lavigne]] won it. It is known from Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d217">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00d217/ las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 31 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-las-vegas-nevada-01-29-00d217/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' [[Kris Lavigne]]
